make_pairs_complete_graph: create image pairs from a list of images using a complete scene graph with optional symmetrization
make_pairs_swiping_window: build image pairs using a sliding window scene graph with configurable window size for sequential images
make_pairs_one_reference: generate image pairs connecting all images to a single reference image in the scene graph
filter_pairs_seq: filter image pairs to keep only those within a specified sequential distance threshold
filter_edges_seq: filter view and prediction edges by sequential distance and return selected views and predictions
